content: {"episode_id":"ep-05051","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for medical necessity, acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness, consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Given the documented personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, the note indicates continuous ambulatory monitoring to characterize arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management."}
